title.zh: 卷十四 本紀第十四 神宗一
title.raw: 卷十四 本紀第十四 神宗一 Volume 14 Annals 14: Shenzong 1

sentences.zh: 神宗紹天法古運德建功英文烈武欽仁聖孝皇帝，諱頊，英宗長子，母曰宣仁聖烈皇后高氏。

translations.literal: Emperor Shenzong, entitled Continuing Heaven, Patterning Antiquity, Transporting Virtue, Establishing Merit, Civil, Martial, Reverent, Benevolent, Sagely, Filial, taboo name Xu, was the eldest son of Yingzong; his mother was Empress Xuanren the Holy and Liege, Lady Gao.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shenzong—full style from Continuing Heaven through Sagely Filial—personal name Xu, was Yingzong’s eldest son; his mother was Empress Xuanren, Lady Gao.

sentences.zh: 慶曆八年四月戊寅生於濮王宮，祥光照室，群鼠吐五色氣成雲。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Glorious Calendar, fourth month, day wuyin, he was born in the Prince of Pu’s palace; auspicious light filled the chamber; a swarm of rats spewed five-colored vapor that formed clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Glorious Calendar 8, fourth month, wuyin: born in the Pu palace amid auspicious light; rats were said to have breathed five-colored clouds.

sentences.zh: 八月，賜名仲鍼。

translations.literal: Eighth month: the name Zhongzhen was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: he was named Zhongzhen.

sentences.zh: 授率府副率，三遷至右千牛衛將軍。

translations.literal: He was made deputy chief of the guard office and thrice promoted to general of the right thousand-oxen guard.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from guard deputy to right thousand-oxen general in three steps.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐八年，侍英宗入居慶甯宮，嘗夢神人捧之登天。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Jiayou he attended Yingzong into residence at Qingning Palace and once dreamed a spirit lifted him to ascend Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Jiayou 8: he entered Qingning Palace with Yingzong and dreamed a spirit bore him to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 英宗即位，授安州觀察使，封光國公。

translations.literal: When Yingzong acceded, he was made observation commissioner of An and Duke of Guangguo.
translations.idiomatic: At Yingzong’s accession he became An commissioner and Duke of Guangguo.

sentences.zh: 是年五月壬戌，受經於東宮。

translations.literal: That year, fifth month, day renxu: he received the classics in the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: That year, fifth month, renxu: he began classical study in the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 帝隆准龍顏，動止皆有常度。

translations.literal: He had a high nose and dragon countenance; movement and rest all had constant measure.
translations.idiomatic: With a high nose and dragon-like bearing, his every motion was measured.

sentences.zh: 而天性好學，請問至日晏忘食，英宗常遣內侍止之。

translations.literal: Yet he loved learning by nature, questioning tutors until dusk and forgetting meals; Yingzong often sent eunuchs to stop him.
translations.idiomatic: He studied until he forgot meals; Yingzong often sent eunuchs to make him stop.

sentences.zh: 帝正衣冠拱手，雖大暑，未嘗用扇。

translations.literal: He wore correct cap and robes with joined hands; even in great heat he never used a fan.
translations.idiomatic: He kept cap and robes formal and never used a fan even in summer heat.

sentences.zh: 侍講王陶入侍，帝率弟顥拜之。

translations.literal: When lecturer Wang Tao entered to attend, the emperor led his brother Hao in bowing to him.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Tao lectured, he had his brother Hao bow with him.

sentences.zh: 九月，加忠武軍節度使、同中書門下平章事，封淮陽郡王，改今諱。

translations.literal: Ninth month: he was added military commissioner of Zhongwu, co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery, Prince of Huaiyang, and his present taboo name was given.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Zhongwu command, co-chancellor, Prince of Huaiyang, and the name Xu.

sentences.zh: 治平元年六月，進封潁王。

translations.literal: Zhiping year one, sixth month: he was advanced to Prince of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiping 1, sixth month: he became Prince of Ying.

sentences.zh: 三年三月，納故相向敏中孫女爲夫人。

translations.literal: Third year, third month: he took the former chief minister Xiang Minzhong’s granddaughter as consort.
translations.idiomatic: Year three, third month: he married Xiang Minzhong’s granddaughter.

sentences.zh: 十月，英宗不豫，帝引仁宗故事，請兩日一御邇英閣講讀，以安人心。

translations.literal: Tenth month: Yingzong was unwell; the emperor cited Renzong’s precedent and asked to lecture in Yingying Hall every two days to steady hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: with Yingzong ill, he asked to lecture in Yingying Hall every two days, citing Renzong’s precedent.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅，立爲皇太子。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renyin: he was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, renyin: he was made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 四年正月丁巳，英廟崩，帝即皇帝位。

translations.literal: Year four, first month, day dingsi: Yingzong’s temple name was closed; the emperor took the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Year four, first month, dingsi: Yingzong died; he became emperor.

sentences.zh: 戊午，赦天下常赦所不原者。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: amnesty even for what the regular amnesty did not spare.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, amnesty beyond the usual limits.

sentences.zh: 遣馮行己告哀於遼。

translations.literal: Feng Xingji was sent to announce mourning to Liao.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Xingji announced mourning to Liao.

sentences.zh: 己未，尊皇太后曰太皇太后，皇后曰皇太后。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the empress dowager was honored Great Empress Dowager; the empress was honored Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the empress became Great Dowager and the consort Dowager.

sentences.zh: 命宰相韓琦爲山陵使。

translations.literal: Chief minister Han Qi was made tomb commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Han Qi became tomb commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，遣孫坦等告即位於遼，以大行皇帝詔賜夏國主及西蕃唃廝囉。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Sun Tan and others announced the accession to Liao; the late emperor’s edict bestowed gifts on the Xia ruler and Gusiluo.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Liao was told of the accession; Xia and Gusiluo received the late emperor’s gifts.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，群臣表三上，始御迎陽門幄殿聽政。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: after three ministerial memorials, he first held government at the Yingyang Gate canopy hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, after three pleas, he began rule at Yingyang Gate.

sentences.zh: 內醫侍先帝疾者，皆坐不謹貶之。

translations.literal: Inner physicians who had attended the late emperor were all punished for negligence.
translations.idiomatic: Physicians who had tended the late emperor were punished for negligence.

sentences.zh: 詔東平郡王允弼、襄陽郡王允良朝朔望。

translations.literal: Edict: Prince of Dongping Yunbi and Prince of Xiangyang Yunliang were to attend on new and full moons.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Yunbi and Yunliang were ordered to attend at each new and full moon.

sentences.zh: 以吳奎終喪，復授樞密副使。

translations.literal: Wu Kui, mourning ended, was again made vice military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Kui, mourning done, returned as vice military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以韓琦守司空兼侍中，曾公亮行門下侍郎兼吏部尚書、進封英國公，文彥博行尚書左僕射、檢校司徒兼中書令，富弼改武甯軍節度使、進封鄭國公，曹佾改昭慶軍節度使、檢校太傅，張昪改河陽三城節度使，宗諤同中書門下平章事，改集慶軍節度使、檢校尚書左僕射，歐陽修、趙槩並加尚書左丞，仍參知政事，陳升之爲戶部侍郎，呂公弼爲刑部侍郎，允弼、允良並加守太保，弟東陽郡王顥進封昌王，鄠國公頵進封樂安郡王。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Han Qi kept minister of works with palace attendant; Zeng Gongliang acting vice director of the Chancellery with personnel minister, advanced Duke of Ying; Wen Yanbo acting left vice director with inspection grand mentor and concurrent director of the Secretariat; Fu Bi changed to Wuning command and Duke of Zheng; Cao Yi changed to Zhaoqing command and grand mentor; Zhang Sheng changed to Heyang command; Zongnu co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery, Jiqing command, inspection left vice director; Ouyang Xiu and Zhao Gai both added left vice director and participating administrator; Chen Shengzhi personnel vice minister; Lü Gongbi punishment vice minister; Yunbi and Yunliang both added acting grand guardian; brother Prince of Dongyang Hao advanced Prince of Chang; Prince of E Yun advanced Prince of Le’an.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the cabinet was reshaped: Han Qi, Zeng Gongliang, Wen Yanbo, Fu Bi, Cao Yi, Zhang Sheng, Zongnu, Ouyang Xiu, Zhao Gai, Chen Shengzhi, Lü Gongbi, and the princes received new ranks and posts.

sentences.zh: 群臣進秩有差。

translations.literal: Officials were advanced in rank by degree.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were promoted by degree.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉，初御紫宸殿。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiyou: for the first time he held court at Zichen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, yiyou: he first held court in Zichen Hall.

sentences.zh: 立向氏爲皇后。

translations.literal: Lady Xiang was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Xiang became empress.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔入內內侍省、皇城司合覆奏事並執條覆奏。

translations.literal: Day dinghai, edict: the inner palace service bureau and imperial city office—joint memorials and line-by-line review.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, inner palace and city offices were ordered to memorial jointly and review item by item.

sentences.zh: 戊子，進封交阯郡王李日尊爲南平王。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Jiaozhi Prince Li Rizun was advanced to Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Li Rizun became Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: 加邈川首領董氈檢校太保。

translations.literal: Miaochuan chief Dong Zhan was added inspection grand guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Zhan of Miaochuan received inspection grand guardian rank.

sentences.zh: 詔山陵所須，應委三司、轉運司計置，毋輒擾民。

translations.literal: Edict: tomb needs were to be planned by the three departments and transport offices without disturbing the people.
translations.idiomatic: Tomb supplies were to come from the three departments without troubling the people.

sentences.zh: 詔提舉醫官院試堪診御脈者六人。

translations.literal: Edict: the medical academy was to test six men fit to feel the imperial pulse.
translations.idiomatic: Six pulse physicians were to be tested at the medical academy.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以四月十日爲同天節。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: the tenth day of the fourth month was made the Shared Heaven festival.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the tenth of the fourth month became Shared Heaven festival.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, a white rainbow crossed the sun.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔公主下嫁者行見舅姑禮。

translations.literal: Day renchen, edict: princesses marrying were to perform the meeting-the-in-laws rite.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, marrying princesses were to meet their in-laws formally.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，西蕃首領拽羅缽、鳩令結二人誘蕃部三百余帳投夏國，捕獲，斬之以徇。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: western Fan chiefs Zhuailuobo and Jiulingjie enticed more than three hundred tents to defect to Xia; captured, they were beheaded as warning.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Fan chiefs who led three hundred tents to Xia were captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸未，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day guiwei: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, guiwei: Venus shone in daylight.

sentences.zh: 甲申，夏國主諒祚遣使謝罪。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Xia ruler Liangzuo sent envoys to apologize.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Liangzuo sent apology envoys.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔齊、密、登、華、邠、耀、鄜、絳、潤、婺、海、宿、饒、歙、吉、建、汀、潮等十八州知州，慶、渭、秦、延四州通判，其選並從中書，毋以恩例奏授。

translations.literal: Day xinmao, edict: prefects of eighteen prefectures and four frontier magistrates—their selection was from the Secretariat, not favor nominations.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, eighteen prefects and four frontier magistrates were to be Secretariat picks, not favors.

sentences.zh: 乙未，張昪以太子太師致仕。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Zhang Sheng retired as grand mentor of the heir.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Zhang Sheng retired as heir’s grand mentor.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔求直言。

translations.literal: Day gengzi, edict: frank counsel was sought.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the throne called for blunt memorials.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞王陶乞許舉知縣資序人爲御史裏行，從之。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Wang Tao asked to nominate men of county-magistrate qualification as censor trainees; assent.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Tao won permission to nominate county-qualified censor trainees.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，王安石出知江寧府。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Wang Anshi went out as prefect of Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Wang Anshi became Jiangning prefect.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔諸路帥臣及副總管或有移易，依慶曆故事。

translations.literal: Day jiachen, edict: when frontier commanders or deputy commissioners moved, Glorious Calendar precedent applied.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, frontier command transfers followed Glorious Calendar rules.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔以孟夏農勞之時，令監司戒飭州縣省事，勸民力田，民有艱食者振之。

translations.literal: Day yisi, edict: in early summer labor, inspectors were to warn prefectures to lighten affairs and urge farming; famine victims were to be relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, early-summer orders urged lighter government and famine relief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚戌，請大行皇帝諡于南郊。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengxu: the late emperor’s posthumous title was requested at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, gengxu: ministers sought the late emperor’s posthumous title.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔內外所上封事，令張方平、司馬光詳定以聞。

translations.literal: Day xinyou, edict: sealed memorials within and without were to be reviewed by Zhang Fangping and Sima Guang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Zhang Fangping and Sima Guang were to review sealed memorials.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，錄囚。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the prisons were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞王陶、侍御史吳申、呂景以過毀大臣，陶出知陳州，申、景各罰銅二十斤。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Wang Tao and investigating censors Wu Shen and Lü Jing were punished for excessive attacks on ministers: Tao went out as Chen prefect; Shen and Jü each fined twenty jin of copper.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Tao, Wu Shen, and Lü Jing, who had savaged ministers, were punished—Tao to Chen, the others twenty jin of copper each.

sentences.zh: 吳奎罷知青州。

translations.literal: Wu Kui was dismissed as acting Qing prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Kui lost the Qing prefecture.

sentences.zh: 遣使循行陝西、河北、京東、京西路，體量安撫。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to tour Shaanxi, Hebei, Jingdong, and Jingxi circuits to inspect conditions and give relief.
translations.idiomatic: Inspectors were dispatched through Shaanxi, Hebei, and the eastern circuits to measure distress and comfort the people.

sentences.zh: 壬申，奎復位。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Kui was restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Wu Kui returned to his post.

sentences.zh: 罷州郡歲貢飲食果藥。

translations.literal: Annual tribute of food, fruit, and medicine from prefectures was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures ceased sending yearly food, fruit, and drug tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔陝西、河東經略、轉運司察主兵臣僚怯懦老病者以聞。

translations.literal: Day guiyou, edict: Shaanxi and Hedong frontier commissioners and transport offices were to report military officials who were timid, aged, or ill.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, frontier offices were told to expose cowardly, aged, or sick commanders.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，以久旱，命宰臣禱雨。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinsi: because of long drought, chief ministers were ordered to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, xinsi: the drought drove the cabinet to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，寶文閣成，置學士、直學士、待制官。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the Baowen Pavilion was completed; academicians, direct academicians, and drafting officials were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Baowen Pavilion opened with its full roster of scholars.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，遼遣蕭余慶等來弔祭。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiyou: Liao sent Xiao Yuqing and others to offer mourning rites.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiyou: Liao envoys came to mourn the late emperor.

sentences.zh: 己未，振河北流民。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Hebei refugees were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Hebei wanderers received relief grain.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔天下官吏有能知徭役利病可議寬減者以聞。

translations.literal: Day xinwei, edict: officials who knew corvée abuses and could propose reductions were to report.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the throne asked officials who understood corvée burdens to propose relief.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔中書、樞密細務歸之有司。

translations.literal: Day yihai, edict: minor Secretariat and Military Affairs business was returned to the proper offices.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, petty Secretariat and Military Affairs matters went back to line agencies.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚辰，詔察富民與妃嬪家婚姻夤緣得官者。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengchen, edict: investigate rich men who gained office through marriage ties with imperial consorts' kin.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, gengchen: the court hunted officials bought with consort-clan marriages.

sentences.zh: 甲申，石蕃來貢。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Shifan came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Shifan presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 己丑，命尚書戶部郎中趙抃、刑部郎中陳薦同詳定中外封事。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Households Minister Zhao Bian and Punishments Minister Chen Jian were ordered jointly to review memorials from within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Zhao Bian and Chen Jian were assigned to sift sealed memorials.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，告英宗憲文肅武宣孝皇帝諡于天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Yingzong's posthumous title Reverent, Civil, Solemn, Martial, Proclaiming Filial was announced to Heaven, Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Yingzong's full posthumous style was proclaimed to Heaven, Earth, temple, and altars.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上寶冊于福寧殿。

translations.literal: Day renchen: the precious register was presented at Funing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the jade book of reign was laid before Funing Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙午，文州曲水縣令宇文之邵上書指陳得失。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Wenzhou Qushui magistrate Yuwen Zhihao memorialized on gains and losses.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, a county magistrate named Yuwen Zhihao sent blunt counsel.

sentences.zh: 八月丁未朔，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingwei, first of month: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, dingwei new moon: Venus shone at noon.

sentences.zh: 戊午，復西夏和市。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: the Xia border market was reopened.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, trade with Western Xia resumed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，京師地震。

translations.literal: Day jisi: the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the capital shook.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，葬英宗於永厚陵。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Yingzong was buried at Yonghou tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Yingzong entered Yonghou tomb.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，漳、泉諸州地震。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingwu: Zhang and Quan prefectures earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingwu: Zhang and Quan shook.

sentences.zh: 丁未，富弼罷判河陽。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Fu Bi was dismissed as Heyang administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Fu Bi left Heyang.

sentences.zh: 戊申，建州、邵武、興化軍地震。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Jian, Shaowu, and Xinghua military prefectures earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Fujian coast prefectures trembled.

sentences.zh: 己酉，初御邇英閣，召侍臣講讀經史。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: for the first time he held lecture in Yingying Hall, summoning attendants to read classics and history.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, he first lectured in Yingying Hall on the classics.

sentences.zh: 以右諫議大夫、權御史中丞滕甫考諸路監司課績。

translations.literal: Right remonstrance officer and acting censor-in-chief Teng Fu was to assess circuit inspectors' performance.
translations.idiomatic: Teng Fu was charged to grade the circuit inspectors.

sentences.zh: 張方平以父憂去位。

translations.literal: Zhang Fangping left office on his father's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Fangping withdrew for mourning.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，給陝西轉運司度僧牒。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: monk certificates were issued to the Shaanxi transport office.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Shaanxi received monk-sale quotas for famine funds.

sentences.zh: 令糴穀振霜旱州縣。

translations.literal: Grain was bought to relieve frost- and drought-stricken prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The court bought grain for frost- and drought-hit counties.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔翰林學士、御史中丞、侍御史知雜事舉材堪御史者各二人。

translations.literal: Day guichou, edict: Hanlin academicians, the censor-in-chief, and the chief investigating censor each nominated two men fit for censor.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, senior scholars and censors were each to name two censor candidates.

sentences.zh: 詔將作監主簿常秩赴闕。

translations.literal: Edict: Palace Directorate registrar Chang Zhi was to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Zhi was summoned from the works registrar's post.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，制《資治通鑒序》賜司馬光。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: he composed the preface to Comprehensive Mirror and bestowed it on Sima Guang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, he wrote the Mirror's preface for Sima Guang.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，知青澗城種諤復綏州。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Qingjian commander Zhong E recovered Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Zhong E took back Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，詔近臣各舉才行可任使者一人。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingchou, edict: each close minister was to recommend one man of talent fit for envoy duty.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dingchou: every court intimate was to name one envoy-worthy man.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔求直言。

translations.literal: Day wuyin, edict: frank counsel was sought.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the throne again called for blunt speech.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔二府各舉所知。

translations.literal: Day bingxu, edict: the two bureaus each recommended men they knew.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, both Secretariat and Military Affairs filed talent lists.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，令考課院詳定諸州所上縣令治狀。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the Performance Review Office was to judge county magistrates' reports of governance.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, magistrates' performance dossiers went to the review office.

sentences.zh: 戊子，分命宰臣祈雪。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: chief ministers were separately ordered to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, each minister prayed for snow in turn.

sentences.zh: 置馬監於河東交城縣。

translations.literal: A horse stud was established at Jiaocheng in Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong's Jiaocheng received a state horse farm.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔近臣以舉官不當，經三劾者，中書別奏取旨。

translations.literal: Day gengyin, edict: when a close minister's nomination proved wrong three times, the Secretariat was to memorialize separately for imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, three failed nominations cost a courtier his referral privilege.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔令內外文武官各舉有材德行能者。

translations.literal: Day yiwei, edict: civil and military officials within and without were each to recommend men of talent, conduct, and ability.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, every official was told to name able men of good character.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，西南龍蕃來貢。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingchen: southwestern Long Fan came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, bingchen: Long Fan of the southwest paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以來歲日食正旦，自乙丑避殿、減膳、罷朝賀。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: because an eclipse would fall on New Year's Day next year, from day yichou the throne avoided the main hall, reduced meals, and canceled court congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, next year's New Year eclipse brought austerity from yichou—no hall, lean table, no felicitations.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔起居日增轉對官二人。

translations.literal: Day renxu, edict: on routine-audience days two more rotating memorialists were added.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, two more speakers were added to daily audiences.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔州縣吏並緣爲奸，致獄多瘐死，歲終會死者多寡，以制其罪。

translations.literal: Day bingyin, edict: when clerks and runners committed fraud and prisoners died in custody, year-end tallies of deaths would fix their punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, jail deaths caused by clerk fraud would be counted yearly and punished.

sentences.zh: 著爲令。

translations.literal: This was enacted as statute.
translations.idiomatic: The rule was written into law.

sentences.zh: 己巳，遼遣蕭傑等來賀正旦。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Liao sent Xiao Jie and others to congratulate the new year.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Liao envoys came for New Year.

sentences.zh: 熙甯元年春正月甲戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Xining year one, spring, first month, day jiaxu, new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Xining 1, first month, jiaxu new moon: the sun was eaten.

sentences.zh: 詔改元。

translations.literal: Edict: the reign era was changed.
translations.idiomatic: The era name was proclaimed Xining.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以旱，減天下囚罪一等，杖以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: because of drought, crimes were reduced one degree empire-wide; those below the cudgel were released.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, drought amnesty cut sentences one grade and freed the lightly punished.

sentences.zh: 壬午，令州縣掩暴骸。

translations.literal: Day renwu: prefectures were ordered to bury exposed corpses.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, counties were told to bury the unburied dead.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命宰臣曾公亮等極言闕失。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: chief ministers Zeng Gongliang and others were ordered to speak freely on omissions.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Zeng Gongliang's cabinet was commanded to name every fault.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，御殿復膳。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: the throne resumed full meals in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the emperor returned to the hall and full rations.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，幸寺觀祈雨。

translations.literal: Day renchen: he visited temples to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, he prayed for rain at the temples.

sentences.zh: 丙申，趙概罷知徐州，三司使唐介參知政事。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Zhao Gai was dismissed as Xuzhou prefect; Three Departments commissioner Tang Jie became participating administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Zhao Gai left Xuzhou and Tang Jie joined the council.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔修《英宗實錄》。

translations.literal: Day dingyou, edict: compile Veritable Records of Yingzong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, work on Yingzong's Veritable Records began.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，增太學生百人。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the Imperial University was increased by one hundred students.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the university gained a hundred seats.

sentences.zh: 二月辛亥，令諸路每季上雨雪。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinhai: each circuit was to report quarterly rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, xinhai: every circuit filed seasonal rainfall.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，孔若蒙襲封衍聖公。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Kong Ruomeng inherited the title Duke of Fulfilled Sageliness.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Kong Ruomeng became Duke of Fulfilled Sageliness.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，貸河東饑民粟。

translations.literal: Day renxu: grain was lent to famine victims in Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Hedong famine victims received grain loans.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰，夏主諒詐卒，遣使來告哀。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengchen: Xia ruler Liangzha died; envoys came to announce mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, gengchen: Liangzha of Xia died; his court sent mourners.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔恤刑。

translations.literal: Day bingxu, edict: show mercy in punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the throne ordered gentler justice.

sentences.zh: 戊子，作太皇太后慶壽宮、皇太后寶慈宮。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: palaces of Longevity for the Great Empress Dowager and of Precious Kindness for the Empress Dowager were built.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, new palaces rose for both empresses dowager.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，簡州木連理，潭州雨毛。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Jian prefecture reported joined tree trunks; Tan prefecture, rain of feathers.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Jian saw conjoined trees and Tan, feather rain.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳，詔翰林學士王安石越次入對。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yisi, edict: Hanlin academician Wang Anshi was to enter audience out of turn.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, yisi: Wang Anshi was summoned ahead of his rank.

sentences.zh: 戊申，命宰臣禱雨。

translations.literal: Day wushen: chief ministers were ordered to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the cabinet prayed for rain again.

sentences.zh: 以樞密直學士李參爲尚書右丞、判西京留守司御史台。

translations.literal: Military Affairs direct academician Li Can was made right vice director and administrator of the Western Capital remonstrance bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Li Can became right vice director at the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，同天節，群臣及遼使初上壽於紫宸殿。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Shared Heaven festival; ministers and Liao envoys first offered longevity felicitations at Zichen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Shared Heaven: court and Liao envoys first wished long life in Zichen Hall.

sentences.zh: 五月甲戌，募饑民補廂軍。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiaxu: famine victims were recruited into the courier guard.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiaxu: starving men were enlisted into the guard.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔兩制及國子監舉諸王宮學官。

translations.literal: Day gengchen, edict: drafting officials and the Directorate of Education were to nominate tutors for the princes' school.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, drafters and the university were to name princes' tutors.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，廢慶成軍。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Qingcheng army was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Qingcheng garrison was disbanded.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯，錄唐魏征、狄仁傑後。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guimao: descendants of Tang's Wei Zheng and Di Renjie were recorded and honored.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, guimao: heirs of Wei Zheng and Di Renjie were ennobled.

sentences.zh: 丁未，占城來貢。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Champa came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Champa sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔諸路興水利。

translations.literal: Day xinhai, edict: each circuit was to promote waterworks.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, every circuit was ordered to dig canals and dikes.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，河決棗強縣。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the Yellow River burst at Zaoqiang county.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the Yellow River broke through at Zaoqiang.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，命司馬光、滕甫裁定國用。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Sima Guang and Teng Fu were ordered to fix state expenditure.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Sima Guang and Teng Fu were told to balance the treasury.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸酉，詔謀殺已傷，案問欲舉自首者，從謀殺減二等。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guiyou, edict: in cases of intended murder where the victim was already wounded and the assailant wished to confess before trial, reduce two degrees from murder.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, guiyou: would-be murderers who surrendered after wounding received two degrees off the capital charge.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，名秦州新築大甘穀口砦曰甘穀城。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the new Qin prefecture fort at Great Sweet Valley Pass was named Sweet Valley city.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Qin's new Sweet Valley fort was proclaimed a city.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔諸路帥臣、監司及兩制、知雜御史已上，各舉武勇謀略三班使臣二名。

translations.literal: Day dingchou, edict: circuit commanders, inspectors, drafting officials, and chief investigating censors and above each nominated two third-rank military envoys of martial courage and stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, every senior official named two bold military agents.

sentences.zh: 賜布衣王安國進士及第。

translations.literal: Commoner Wang Anguo was granted jinshi standing.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anguo, a commoner, passed the jinshi.

sentences.zh: 己卯，群臣三表請上奉元憲道文武仁孝之號，不許。

translations.literal: Day jimao: ministers thrice memorialized the style Upholding Origin, Sagely Way, Civil, Martial, Benevolent, Filial; refused.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, three pleas for a grand honorific title were refused.

sentences.zh: 陳升之知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Chen Shengzhi became Military Affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shengzhi took Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 給濮州雷澤縣堯陵守戶。

translations.literal: Households were assigned to guard Yao tomb in Leize, Pu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Pu's Leize received guard households for Emperor Yao's mound.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以恩、冀州河決，賜水死家緡錢及下戶粟。

translations.literal: Day renwu: because the En and Ji prefecture river had burst, cash was given families of the drowned and grain to poor households.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Hebei flood victims received cash and grain.

sentences.zh: 甲申，京師地震。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the capital shook again.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，又震，大雨。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: again it shook; great rain.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, a second quake and torrential rain.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以河朔地大震，命沿邊安撫司及雄州刺史候遼人動息以聞。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: because of the great Hebei earthquake, frontier pacification offices and Xiong prefecture were to watch Khitan movements and report.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the Hebei quake put border offices on alert for Liao.

sentences.zh: 賜壓死者緡錢。

translations.literal: Cash was given to those crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: Families of the buried received relief money.

sentences.zh: 京師地再震。

translations.literal: The capital earth shook twice more.
translations.idiomatic: The capital trembled twice again.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣御史中丞滕甫、知制誥吳充安撫河北。

translations.literal: Day renchen: censor-in-chief Teng Fu and drafting academician Wu Chong were sent to pacify Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Teng Fu and Wu Chong went to comfort Hebei.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，疏深州溢水。

translations.literal: Day guisi: overflow from Shen prefecture was drained.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Shenzhou's flood was channeled off.

sentences.zh: 甲午，減河北路囚罪一等。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Hebei circuit prisoners' crimes were reduced one degree.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Hebei sentences were cut one grade.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賜河北安撫司空名誥敕，募民入粟。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Hebei pacification commissioner was given blank commission patents; the people were urged to sell grain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Hebei was told to buy grain with blank patents.

sentences.zh: 己亥，回鶻來貢。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the Uighurs came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Uighur envoys arrived.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，詔京東、西路存恤河北流民。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renyin, edict: Jingdong and Jingxi were to care for Hebei refugees.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, renyin: eastern circuits sheltered Hebei refugees.

sentences.zh: 京師地震。

translations.literal: The capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: The capital shook once more.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，又震。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: again it shook.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, another tremor.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賜河東及鄜延路轉運司空名誥敕，募民入粟實邊。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Hedong and Yan-Yan transport commissioners were given blank patents; the people were urged to sell grain to fill the frontier stores.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the northwest was urged to sell grain for frontier granaries.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔中書門下，考屬近行尊者一人，王之。

translations.literal: Day jiazi, edict to the Secretariat-Chancellery: examine one senior kinsman of recent imperial descent and enfeoff him as king.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the Secretariat was told to enfeoff one senior Song clansman as prince.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，罷宗諤平章事。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Zongnu was dismissed as co-director.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Zongnu left the council.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，遣張宗益等賀遼主生辰、正旦。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Zhang Zongyi and others were sent to congratulate the Liao ruler's birthday and new year.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, envoys left for Liao's birthday and New Year.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，太祖曾孫舒國公從式進封安定郡王。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinwei: Taizu's great-great-grandson Prince of Shu Congshi was advanced to Prince of Anding.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, xinwei: Congshi became Prince of Anding.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，減後妃臣僚薦奏推恩。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: favor extensions through consort and official nominations were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, empresses' and officials' favor nominations were trimmed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，莫州地震，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Mo prefecture earthquake; sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Mo prefecture shook with a sound like thunder.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔三司裁定宗室月料，嫁娶、生日、郊禮給賜。

translations.literal: Day dingyou, edict: the Three Departments were to fix monthly stipends for the imperial clan, and gifts for marriage, birthdays, and suburban rites.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, clan stipends and ritual gifts were put on a fixed budget.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛丑，給天下系囚衣食薪炭。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinchou: clothing, food, and fuel were given prisoners empire-wide.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, xinchou: every jail received winter clothes and fuel.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，出奉宸庫珠，付河北買馬。

translations.literal: Day yimao: pearls from the inner treasure were released to Hebei to buy horses.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, palace pearls went to Hebei for horses.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，禁銷金服飾。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: melting gold for clothing ornament was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, gold-thread robes were banned.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸酉，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guiyou: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, guiyou: Venus shone at noon.

sentences.zh: 癸未，命宰臣禱雪。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: chief ministers were ordered to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the cabinet prayed for snow.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，朝饗太廟，遂齋于郊宮。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the ancestral temple was feasted; then fasting at the suburban palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the court feasted the ancestors and fasted at the suburban lodge.

sentences.zh: 廢青城後苑。

translations.literal: The rear garden of Green City was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Green City's rear park was closed.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，祀天地於圜丘，大赦，群臣進秩有差。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Heaven and Earth were sacrificed at the round altar; great amnesty; officials advanced in rank by degree.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the round-altar rites brought amnesty and widespread promotion.

sentences.zh: 乙未，京師及莫州地震。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: the capital and Mo prefecture earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, capital and Mo shook again.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥朔，命宰臣禱雪。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jihai, first of month: chief ministers were ordered to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jihai new moon: the cabinet prayed for snow.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，瀛州地大震。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Ying prefecture great earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Yingzhou suffered a violent quake.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，賜夏國主秉常詔，許納塞門、安遠二砦歸其綏州。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: an edict was bestowed on Xia ruler Bingchang permitting return of Saimen and Anyuan forts in exchange for Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Bingchang was offered Suizhou if he returned Saimen and Anyuan.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，錄唐段秀實後。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: descendants of Tang's Duan Xiushi were recorded and honored.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Duan Xiushi's heirs were ennobled.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，禱雪於郊廟、社稷。

translations.literal: Day guichou: snow was prayed for at suburban temples and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, snow prayers filled the suburban shrines.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以判汝州富弼爲集禧觀使，詔乘驛赴闕。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Fu Bi, administrator of Ruzhou, was made commissioner of Jixi Abbey and ordered post-haste to court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Fu Bi was recalled from Ruzhou at gallop.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，雪。

translations.literal: Day renxu: snow.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, snow fell at last.

sentences.zh: 甲子，遼遣耶律公質等來賀正旦。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Liao sent Yelü Gongzhi and others to congratulate the new year.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Liao envoys came for New Year.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月甲午，奉安英宗神御于景靈宮英德殿。

translations.literal: Year two, spring, first month, day jiawu: Yingzong's spirit tablet was installed at Yingde Hall, Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Year two, first month, jiawu: Yingzong's spirit entered Jingling's Yingde Hall.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，以富弼同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Second month, day jihai: Fu Bi was made co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jihai: Fu Bi joined the council.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以王安石參知政事。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Wang Anshi became participating administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Wang Anshi entered the council.

sentences.zh: 命翰林學士呂公著修《英宗實錄》。

translations.literal: Hanlin academician Lü Gongzhu was ordered to compile Veritable Records of Yingzong.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Gongzhu was assigned Yingzong's Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，帝以災變避正殿，減膳徹樂。

translations.literal: Day yisi: because of omens, the emperor avoided the main hall, reduced meals, and withdrew music.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, portents brought austerity—no hall, lean table, no music.

sentences.zh: 甲子，陳升之、王安石創置三司條例，議行新法。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Chen Shengzhi and Wang Anshi created the Three Departments Regulations Office to debate new laws.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Chen and Wang founded the New Policies bureau.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉，詔漕運、鹽鐵等官各具財用利害以聞。

translations.literal: Third month, day yiyou, edict: transport, salt, and iron officials each memorialized fiscal gains and losses.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, yiyou: revenue officers filed cost-and-benefit reports.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命宰臣禱雨。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: chief ministers were ordered to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the cabinet prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 戊子，秉常上誓表，納塞門、安遠二砦，乞綏州，詔許之。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Bingchang submitted a sworn memorial, returning Saimen and Anyuan forts and begging Suizhou; edict granted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Bingchang swore to return two forts for Suizhou; the throne agreed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以旱慮囚。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: because of drought, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, drought brought a prison review.

sentences.zh: 四月丁酉朔，群臣再上尊號，不許。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day dingyou, new moon: ministers again offered a grand honorific; refused.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, dingyou new moon: another honorific title was refused.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，省內外土木工。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: civil and military construction within and without was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, palace and public works were halted.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，遼遣耶律昌等來賀同天節。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Liao sent Yelü Chang and others to congratulate Shared Heaven festival.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Liao envoys came for Shared Heaven.

sentences.zh: 丁未，唐介薨，臨其喪。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Tang Jie died; the emperor attended the mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Tang Jie died; the emperor mourned at his bier.

sentences.zh: 戊申，宰臣富弼、曾公亮以旱上表待罪，詔不允。

translations.literal: Day wushen: chief ministers Fu Bi and Zeng Gongliang submitted guilt memorials over drought; edict refused.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Fu Bi and Zeng Gongliang offered resignations over drought; refused.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命曾公亮爲西京奏安仁宗、英宗御容禮儀使。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Zeng Gongliang was made ritual commissioner for installing Renzong and Yingzong portraits at the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Zeng Gongliang oversaw Western Capital portrait rites.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，遣使諸路，察農田水利賦役。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: envoys were sent on each circuit to inspect farmland, waterworks, and tax corvée.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, inspectors fanned out to audit fields, canals, and levies.

sentences.zh: 戊午，外任大使臣年七十以上，令監司體量，直除致仕者，更不與子孫推恩。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: for outer officials seventy and above, if the circuit inspector judged them fit for direct retirement, their descendants would receive no further favor extensions.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, direct retirement at seventy ended heirs' favor nominations.

sentences.zh: 甲子，御殿復膳。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: the throne resumed full meals in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the emperor returned to full rations.

sentences.zh: 免河北歸業流民夏稅。

translations.literal: Summer tax was remitted for Hebei refugees returning to their fields.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei returnees were freed from summer tax.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未，宴紫宸殿，初用樂。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinwei: a banquet at Zichen Hall; music was used for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, xinwei: Zichen Hall banquet—music returned.

sentences.zh: 己卯，賜河北役兵特支錢。

translations.literal: Day jimao: special pay was given Hebei corvée troops.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Hebei labor troops received bonus cash.

sentences.zh: 癸未，翰林學士鄭獬罷知杭州，宣徽北院使王拱辰罷判應天府，知制誥錢公輔罷知江寧府。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Hanlin academician Zheng Xie was dismissed as Hang prefect; North Courtyard commissioner Wang Gongchen as Ying prefect; drafting academician Qian Gongfu as Jiangning prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Zheng Xie, Wang Gongchen, and Qian Gongfu were sent out of the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，奉安仁宗、英宗御容于會聖宮及應天院。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: portraits of Renzong and Yingzong were installed at Huisheng Palace and Yingtian Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Renzong and Yingzong entered their portrait halls.

sentences.zh: 甲午，減西京囚罪一等。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Western Capital prisoners' crimes were reduced one degree.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Luoyang sentences were cut one grade.

sentences.zh: 台州民延贊等九人，年各百歲以上，並授本州助教。

translations.literal: Taizhou commoners Yan Zan and eight others, each over one hundred years, were all made assistant instructors of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Nine Taizhou elders past one hundred became honorary prefectural instructors.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，右諫議大夫、御史中丞呂誨以論王安石，罷知鄧州。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingsi: right remonstrance officer and censor-in-chief Lü Hui was dismissed as Deng prefect for criticizing Wang Anshi.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, dingsi: Lü Hui, who had attacked Wang Anshi, was sent to Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士呂公著爲御史中丞。

translations.literal: Hanlin academician Lü Gongzhu was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Gongzhu became censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 命龍圖閣直學士張掞兼編排錄用勳臣子孫。

translations.literal: Dragon Diagram direct academician Zhang Shan was also ordered to compile and employ descendants of meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shan was told to register meritorious ministers' heirs for office.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Venus appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Venus shone at noon.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙丑朔，日當食，雲陰不見。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yichou, new moon: an eclipse was due; clouds hid it.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, yichou new moon: clouds veiled the expected eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔御史中丞舉推直官及可兼權御史者。

translations.literal: Day gengwu, edict: the censor-in-chief was to nominate push investigators and men fit to act as censors.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the censor-in-chief was to name bold investigators.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，東平郡王允弼薨。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Prince of Dongping Yunbi died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Prince Yunbi died.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，立淮、浙、江、湖六路均輸法。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the equal-transport law was established on the Huai, Zhe, Jiang, and lake circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the equal-transport system began on six southeastern circuits.

sentences.zh: 壬午，振恤被水州軍，仍蠲竹木稅及酒課。

translations.literal: Day renwu: flood-struck prefectures and armies were relieved; bamboo-wood tax and wine levy were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, flood counties were fed and their timber and wine taxes forgiven.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔自今文臣換右職者，須實有謀勇，曾著績效，即得取旨。

translations.literal: Day guiwei, edict: from now on when civil officials exchanged to military rank, they must truly have counsel and courage and recorded achievement before imperial approval.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, civil-to-military transfers required proven battlefield merit.

sentences.zh: 甲申，日下有五色雲。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: five-colored clouds appeared beneath the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, five-colored clouds ringed the sun.

sentences.zh: 己丑，韓琦上《仁宗實錄》，曾公亮上《英宗實錄》。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Han Qi presented Veritable Records of Renzong; Zeng Gongliang presented Veritable Records of Yingzong.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Renzong's and Yingzong's Veritable Records were submitted.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，侍御史劉琦貶監處州鹽酒務，御史裏行錢顗貶監衢州鹽稅，亦以論安石故。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guimao: attendant censor Liu Qi was demoted to salt-and-wine commissioner of Chuzhou; censor trainee Qian Yi to salt tax of Quzhou—both for criticizing Anshi.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, guimao: Liu Qi and Qian Yi, who had opposed Anshi, were banished to salt posts.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，殿中侍御史孫昌齡以論新法，貶通判蘄州。

translations.literal: Day yisi: palace attendant Sun Changling was demoted to Tong prefect for criticizing the new laws.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Sun Changling was exiled for attacking the New Policies.

sentences.zh: 丙午，同修起居注範純仁以言事多忤安石，罷同知諫院。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: co-author of the diary Fan Chunren was dismissed as co-director of the Remonstrance Bureau for repeatedly opposing Anshi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Fan Chunren lost his remonstrance post for defying Anshi.

sentences.zh: 戊申，河徙東行。

translations.literal: Day wushen: the Yellow River shifted eastward.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the Yellow River turned east.

sentences.zh: 夏國請從舊蕃儀，詔許之。

translations.literal: Western Xia asked to follow the old Fan ritual; edict granted.
translations.idiomatic: Xia was permitted its former tribal rites.

sentences.zh: 己酉，範純仁知河中府。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Fan Chunren was made Hezhong prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Fan Chunren went to Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，朝神御殿。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: audience at the Spirit Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the court met at the Spirit Hall.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以秘書省著作佐郎程顥、王子韶並爲太子中允、權監察御史裏行。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Secretariat registrars Cheng Hao and Wang Zishao were both made crown prince attendants and acting investigating censors.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Cheng Hao and Wang Zishao became acting censors.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，待御史知雜事劉述、同判刑部丁諷坐受刑名敕不即下，述貶知江州，諷貶通判復州。

translations.literal: Day renxu: chief investigating censor Liu Shu and Punishments co-administrator Ding Feng were punished for delaying a penal edict: Shu demoted to Jiang prefect; Feng to Tong prefect of Fu.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Liu Shu and Ding Feng were punished for sitting on a penal edict.

sentences.zh: 審刑院詳議官王師元坐言許遵所議刑名不當，貶監安州稅。

translations.literal: Detailed deliberation officer Wang Shiyuan of the Review Office was punished for saying Xu Zun's penal opinion was wrong; demoted to An tax commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shiyuan was exiled for rejecting Xu Zun's harsh code.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子朔，交州來貢。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiazi, new moon: Jiaozhi came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiazi new moon: Jiaozhi sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以古勿峒效順首領儂智會爲右千牛衛大將軍。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Gumu Cave submitter chief Nong Zhihui was made great general of the right thousand-oxen guard.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Nong Zhihui of Gumu Cave received a general's rank.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，立常平給斂法。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the ever-normal granary loan-and-storage law was established.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the ever-normal granary system was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，出內庫緡錢百萬糴河北常平粟。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: one million strings from the inner treasury bought ever-normal grain in Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, a million strings bought Hebei reserve grain.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，遣孫固等賀遼主生辰、正旦。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Sun Gu and others were sent to congratulate the Liao ruler's birthday and new year.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Sun Gu's mission left for Liao.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，廢奉慈廟。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Fengci temple was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Fengci temple was closed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以秘書省著作佐郎呂惠卿爲太子中允、崇政殿說書。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Secretariat registrar Lü Huiqing was made crown prince attendant and lecturer at Chongzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Lü Huiqing entered the heir's school and lecture hall.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，富弼罷爲武甯軍節度使、判亳州。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingshen: Fu Bi was dismissed as Wuning military commissioner and Bozhou administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingshen: Fu Bi left the council for Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 曾公亮、陳升之並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Zeng Gongliang and Chen Shengzhi both became co-directors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Gongliang and Chen Shengzhi became co-chancellors.

sentences.zh: 城綏州，命郭逵選將置守具。

translations.literal: Suizhou was walled; Guo Kui was ordered to choose generals and prepare defenses.
translations.idiomatic: Suizhou was fortified; Guo Kui chose garrison commanders.

sentences.zh: 逵遣趙禼交夏人所納安遠、塞門二砦，就定地界。

translations.literal: Kui sent Zhao Xi to receive the two forts Anyuan and Saimen that the Xia had surrendered and fix the border.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Kui sent Zhao Xi to take Xia's two forts and fix the line.

sentences.zh: 夏人渝初盟，禼請城綏州，不以易二砦，因改名綏德城。

translations.literal: The Xia broke the first treaty; Xi asked to wall Suizhou without trading the two forts; it was therefore renamed Suide city.
translations.idiomatic: When Xia broke faith, Zhao Xi walled Suizhou without yielding the forts—the place was renamed Suide.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以蕃官禮賓使折繼世爲忠州刺史，左監門衛將軍嵬名山爲供備庫使，仍賜姓名趙懷順。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Fan official ritual guest commissioner Zhe Jishi was made Zhong prefect; left gate guard general Wei Mingshan was made supply commissioner and given the surname Zhao and name Huaihun.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, frontier officers Zhe Jishi and Wei Mingshan were ennobled as Zhao Huaihun.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔御史請對，並許直由閣門上殿。

translations.literal: Day bingchen, edict: censors requesting audience were permitted direct access through the Gate Office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, censors won the right to petition straight through the gate.

sentences.zh: 戊午，宗諤復平章事。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Zongnu again became co-director.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Zongnu returned to the council.

sentences.zh: 己未，夏人來謝封冊。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the Xia came to thank the investiture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Xia envoys thanked the throne for the seal.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，錄楊承信曾孫立、田重進曾孫章爲三班借職。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Yang Chengxin's great-grandson Li and Tian Zhongjin's great-grandson Zhang were recorded as third-rank agents.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, heirs of Yang Chengxin and Tian Zhongjin entered service.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，命韓絳制置三司條例。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yichou: Han Jiang was made director of the Three Departments Regulations Office.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, yichou: Han Jiang took the New Policies office.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔祖宗之後世襲補外官，非袒免親罷賜名授官。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu, edict: descendants of the founders who inherited outer offices were not to receive bestowed names and appointment unless within the five mourning degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, distant imperial clansmen lost automatic favor appointments.

sentences.zh: 丙子，罷諸路提刑武臣。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: military circuit penal inspectors were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, military judicial inspectors were removed.

sentences.zh: 頒《農田水利約束》。

translations.literal: Regulations on farmland and waterworks were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: The Farmland and Waterworks code was issued.

sentences.zh: 壬午，御邇英閣聽講。

translations.literal: Day renwu: he heard lecture in Yingying Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, he lectured again in Yingying Hall.

sentences.zh: 賜汴口役兵錢。

translations.literal: Cash was given corvée troops at the Bian ford.
translations.idiomatic: Bian River labor troops received bonus pay.

sentences.zh: 己丑，減天下囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day jichou: crimes were reduced one degree empire-wide; those below exile were released.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, a general amnesty cut sentences and freed the lightly punished.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚子，浚御河。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day gengzi: the imperial canal was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, gengzi: the imperial canal was cleared.

sentences.zh: 壬子，置交子務。

translations.literal: Day renzi: the paper-money office was established.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the government note bureau opened.

sentences.zh: 是月，差官提舉諸路常平廣惠倉，兼管勾農田水利差役事。

translations.literal: That month: officials were dispatched to superintend ever-normal and broad-relief granaries on each circuit and also manage farmland, waterworks, and corvée affairs.
translations.idiomatic: That month, granary commissioners on every circuit also took charge of fields, water, and corvée.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥朔，復減後妃公主及臣僚推恩。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guihai, new moon: favor extensions for consorts, princesses, and officials were again reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guihai new moon: empresses' and officials' favor grants were cut again.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，增失入死罪法。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the law on erroneous capital conviction was increased.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, penalties for wrongful death sentences were stiffened.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，增三京留司御史台、國子監及宮觀官，以處卿監、監司、知州之老者。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: posts at the three capital remonstrance bureaus, the Imperial University, and abbey offices were increased to place aged ministers, inspectors, and prefects.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, sinecures multiplied for retired senior officials.

sentences.zh: 戊子，遼遣蕭惟禧來賀正旦。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Liao sent Xiao Weixi and others to congratulate the new year.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Liao envoys came for New Year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，交州來貢。

translations.literal: That year: Jiaozhi came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Jiaozhi again sent tribute.
